integrity: The channel law and the published five columns are explicitly reconstructed. Two exact maximum-likelihood success polynomials are proved by an output-support partition and independently verified through full 256-output symbolic enumeration and rational likelihood comparison. The competing code uses the same original weak-flip column family.
scientific_limitations: The only optimality conclusion is strict suboptimality of a specified published five-message Z-channel length-eight codebook throughout the explicit high-flip interval. Neither alternative global optimality nor a result at other lengths or at p outside the interval is asserted.
title: A high-noise counterexample to the five-message Z-channel recursion at length eight
